The FloPlast 110mm single socket pipe coupler is engineered for secure connections within soil and vent drainage systems. Constructed from robust uPVC, this black pipe fitting delivers reliable performance and exceptional durability for long-term use. Its versatile design supports both push-fit and solvent weld jointing methods, offering flexibility for trade professionals on site. Ideal for connecting 110mm soil pipes in various waste water systems, this lightweight coupler is also suitable for handling high temperature waste discharges, ensuring efficient installations. The use of silicone lubricant on all seals will facilitate jointing.
